summary: Explains where to put collection unit tests under tests/unit/plugins mirroring the source path, and how to run all, a specific Python version, or a single test file with ansible-test units; extra requirements go in tests/unit/requirements.txt.
questions: Where should unit tests for a module_util live in a collection?
How do I run unit tests for just one Python version?
How do I run a single unit test file with ansible-test?
Where do I list Python packages needed by my unit tests?

answer_card.title: Collection unit tests
answer_card.answer_md:
Place tests under `tests/unit/plugins/` mirroring the source, e.g. `plugins/module_utils/foo/bar.py` → `tests/unit/plugins/module_utils/foo/test_bar.py`.
```shell-session
ansible-test units --docker default -v
ansible-test units --docker default -v --python 3.13
ansible-test units --docker default -v --python 3.13 tests/unit/plugins/module_utils/foo/test_bar.py
```
Put Python requirements in `tests/unit/requirements.txt`.
